Cell Map of a MacroPCA Fit

Source: R/plot_robust_pca.R
plot_cell_map.Rd

Shows which cells of the data deviate from a macropca() fit, with cellWise::cellMap(). Each cell is colored by its standardized residual: red when the observed value is much higher than the fit, blue when it is much lower. Rows of outlying observations are marked.

Usage

plot_cell_map(
  object,
  rows = NULL,
  columns = NULL,
  nrowsinblock = NULL,
  ncolumnsinblock = NULL,
  title = "MacroPCA cell map",
  ...
)

Arguments

object

An object returned by macropca().

rows, columns

Optional indices or names of the rows and columns to show. Default is all.

nrowsinblock, ncolumnsinblock

Optional numbers of rows and columns combined into one block.

title

The plot title.

...

Further arguments passed to cellWise::cellMap(), such as rowlabels, columnlabels or columnangle.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Spectra have many more variables than can be shown one by one. Use columns to select a spectral region, and ncolumnsinblock (and nrowsinblock) to combine adjacent cells into blocks; the color of a block then summarizes its cells. By default, the columns are grouped into blocks when there are more than 60 of them.

See also

macropca(), plot_outlier_map()

Examples

set.seed(1)
x <- matrix(rnorm(40 * 8), 40, 8) %*% diag(8:1)
x[1:2, ] <- x[1:2, ] + 20
x[10, 2] <- 40
fit <- macropca(x, k = 2)
plot_cell_map(fit)
